panels.title: Imperial defensive ring in colonial frontier policy
ascii_lines: FOCUS -> Imperial defensive ring
EVIDENCE -> British India treated neighbouring states and frontier zones as a strategic ring
around the Indian empire.
EXAM USE -> use Imperial defensive ring to match actor, date, mechanism and limit.
LIMIT -> do not transfer Imperial defensive ring to another institution or theatre.
MUST REMEMBER: Keep the Afghan wars (1839-42, 1878-80, 1919), Burma wars (1824-26, 1852,
1885), Nepal war and Treaty of Sugauli (1814-16), and Younghusband mission to Tibet
(1903-04) distinct.
source_references: India and Her Neighbours (Afghanistan, Burma, Nepal, Tibet, NW Frontier)
